plain_description.what: A planned paid judging run (up to 3,000 matches) on the MATH cell. It was stopped by its launch gate before any call: many MATH answers had been cut off by a 1,024-token generation limit, and the rules forbid judging cut-off answers.
plain_description.why: It guards against a judged result driven by truncated answers rather than model ability.
plain_description.information: It shows the gate works and decides which population may be judged. Result: withdrawn (held, zero calls). It was re-registered on the questions where both answers finished (STAGE3-MATH-CAPFREE), which passed. The original population stays unjudged.
